name: assetopsbench-uniform-failed-run-outcomes
instr:
The agent runner library cannot represent every terminal attempt uniformly without losing trustworthy partial work. Add `run_attempt` without changing `run`. Every concrete runner must return one terminal `RunOutcome`: success carries the same `AgentResult` as `run`, failure carries a stable phase and diagnostics, and cancellation remains distinct.

Preserve all and only complete native work and available usage in partial trajectories, including the distinct history boundaries of Claude, DeepAgent, OpenAI, Stirrup, OpenCode, DirectLLM, and PlanExecute. Keep process termination, malformed output, planning, execution, summarization, generation, and answer processing observably distinct. Finalization publishes at most one run-correlated record. Cleanup and persistence errors must not replace the outcome or cause another publication. Existing `run` answers, trajectories, serialization, cleanup, returns, and exception propagation must remain unchanged.

Offline evaluation must accept legacy successes and terminal attempts, preserve identity and partial data, load each run once, and report deterministic totals by runner, status, and phase. A completed Claude tool response must survive an SDK failure, persistence, and loading. Complete OpenCode events before malformed trailing output must retain order, diagnostics, and usage. Cancellation between resolved plan steps must return ordered completed steps without a fabricated pending-step failure. DirectLLM must preserve its cleaned ans
